Production Access Approved

Hello {!$Record.Developer_Name__c},

Your production access request for {!Project_Details.Project_Name__c} has been approved.

Ticket Number
#{!$Record.Ticket_Number__c}

textTemplates.name: EndAccessEmailBodyForAuthorizerwithWithoutPass
textTemplates.text:
Production Access Ticket Completed

Hello,

This is to inform you that the production access period for Ticket #{!$Record.Ticket_Number__c} for project {!Get_Authorizers_Email.Project_Name__c} has been completed.

Production Account
{!ProductionUser}
Access End Time
{!$Record.Requested_End__c}

Password Reset Status

The production account password has not been reset at this time, as another production access ticket is currently under process for the same account.

Next Action

Once the other active production access ticket is completed, the production account password will be reset and the new password will be securely shared with you.

No action is required from your side at this time.

Regards,

Production Access Security Team
